description: Android permissions: the camera for reading the pairing QR, file import/export through the native dialogs, and smart-lab lookups, minus the window/updater plugins that have no mobile implementation. An imported file is read as raw bytes (fs:allow-read-file) so a bank statement in Windows-1251 can be decoded on our side; an export is written where the person picked it (fs:allow-write-text-file). Nothing else in the app reads directories, reads text files or removes files through the fs plugin, so those permissions are not granted, and the app's own data directories ($APPDATA, $APPLOCALDATA — the WebView's storage among them) are not in the fs scope. The opener scope is pinned to this project's releases. The http scope ends with https://* and https://*:* because the sync server's address is typed by its owner at runtime and cannot be pinned at build time; it belongs to the main webview, so the defence is keeping foreign scripts out of the page: the CSP admits only the app's own bundled scripts (script-src 'self' plus the hashes and nonces Tauri adds for inline scripts at build time — no 'unsafe-inline'), and no user or server data is rendered as HTML.
